## Non-Standard Software

This appendix identifies the Software (SW) products specific to each server that are non-standard in variance from the gold standard identified in *SDP\_Enterprise\_Appendix\_E\_Standard\_Software.docx*.

For each component/server listed, the SW column identifies the product, while the description column identifies what specific service is being provided by the product.

This listing is current as of the document submission date.

All SW (standard and non-standard) shall have a clearly defined business justification and be supported by a certified vendor, to include but not limited to, security patches and updates.

SW is subjected to the Protection Considerations section of the Enterprise Wide Service Design Package (SDP).

SW introduction into the production environment follows the standard change control processes, to include the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) Change Advisory Board/Change Control Board (CAB/CCB) in which the change ticket is reviewed and approved by the client representatives.

SW to be introduced post build is first validated in a test environment prior to introduction into the production environment.
